part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `getPagesInSection` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:332): the non-recursive branch-skip logic kept only a single `otherBranch` prefix. Since radix-tree keys are visited in lexical order (`/s1`, `/s1-foo`, `/s1/p1`, `/s1/p2`), visiting `/s1-foo` overwrote the prefix `/s1/`, so descendants of `s1` (and of any similarly-prefixed earlier branch) were wrongly included in `.Pages`.

The fix replaces the single-prefix tracking with the walker's `SkipPrefix(key + "/")` when a branch node is encountered, so each branch's descendants are skipped independently — mirroring the approach already used in `Sections()` (hugolib/page__tree.go).

Validation: `TestPagesSimilarSectionNames` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case, issue #12169) passes, and the full `./hugolib/` and `./hugolib/doctree/` test suites pass (`go build ./...` fails only on missing network for unrelated packages; the changed packages compile and test fine).
